horizon.extras.dynamic_lights.tooltip: Ọwa na isi iyi ọkụ ndị ọzọ ejidere, wụsara ma ọ bụ na-enwu ọkụ n'ihe mgbochi gbara ha gburugburu.

horizon.extras.hide_block_particles.tool: Na-ezobe irighiri irighiri ihe ndị na-esi na ngọngọ gbajiri agbaji wee dapụsịa nke ị nwere. Ihe ndị ọzọ na-anọ.
horizon.extras.horizon_marks.tooltip: Gosi logo Horizon n'akụkụ ndị ọkpụkpọ Horizon: obere logo n'ihu aha ndị ọkpụkpọ ndị ọzọ na-eji Horizon, n'elu isi ha na na ndepụta ndị ọkpụkpọ. Naanị ndị ọkpụkpọ Horizon na-ahụ ya: sava anaghị enweta ihe ọ bụla.
horizon.extras.horizon_me.tooltip: Gosi m dịka onye ọkpụkpọ Horizon: ndị ọkpụkpọ Horizon ndị ọzọ na-ahụ logo ahụ n'akụkụ aha gị. Gbanye, ọrụ ahụ na-aza onye ọ bụla jụrụ banyere gị na i gbara Horizon n'ime awa 3 gara aga; gbanyụọ, ọ naghị akọ banyere gị.
horizon.extras.mouse_tweaks.tooltip: Dọrọ aka nri ebe otu oghere, aka ekpe na-achịkọta ihe ejidere, Mgbanwe + aka ekpe na-ebugharị oghere ọ bụla.
horizon.extras.mouse_tweaks_wheel.toolti: Ala na-eziga otu ihe nke oghere ahụ n'akụkụ nke ọzọ, elu na-eweghachi otu azụ.
horizon.extras.music_page.tooltip: Egwu & Ụda na-enweta Egwu... ibe: Kpọọ egwu arụnyere n'ime ya ugbu a, ma ọ bụ gbanyụọ otu ka egwuregwu ahụ kwụsị iburu ya. Ọ nweghị ihe na-agbanwe ruo mgbe ịgbanyụrụ egwu.
horizon.extras.no_ai.tooltip: Na-ezo ma gbanyụọ njirimara AI niile: njikwa onye nnọchite, horizon-ctl na sava MCP. Mgbanwe nke onye nrụpụta kwa.
horizon.extras.own_name_tag.tooltip: Na-egosi aha gị n'elu isi gị na onye nke atọ, dị ka ndị egwuregwu ndị ọzọ na-ahụ ya. Zoro ezo mgbe ihe nkesa ahụ zoro aha otu gị ma ọ bụ na ị naghị ahụ anya.
horizon.extras.pack_browser.tooltip: Họrọ Ngwungwu akụrụngwa na-enweta bọtịnụ Tinye nke na-achọ Modrinth ma tinye otu mkpọ n'ime folda mkpọ gị. Gbanyụọ, egwuregwu anaghị akpọtụrụ Modrinth.
horizon.extras.pregen.tooltip: Na-enyere /pregen aka n'ụwa otu onye na nke LAN gị. Ọ bụrụ na agbanyela cheats, jiri /pregen start mepụta mpaghara tupu i nyochaa ya. Ọ naghị agbanye iwu a na sava ndị i jikọtara.
horizon.extras.repro_keys.tooltip: F3+R na-amalite ma ọ bụ kwụsị ndekọ repro na F3+E na-ede ngwugwu ya. Gbanyụọ na ndabara: ndekọ ndekọ ụwa.
horizon.extras.sort.tooltip: Hazie ngwa ahịa, igbe, gbọmgbọm, igbe ender na igbe shulker n'usoro taabụ okike, na-ejikọta ọnụ.
horizon.extras.sort_key.tooltip: Hazie akụkụ n'okpuru cursor. Pịa, wee pịa igodo; Ụzọ mgbapụ na-ekekọta ya.
horizon.extras.splitscreen.tooltip: N'ime ụwa, onye njikwa ọzọ nwere ike isonyere dị ka onye ọkpụkpọ ọhụrụ: pịa A mgbe ọ jụrụ, wee họrọ profaịlụ na ebe ị ga-egwu.
horizon.extras.ui_sound_reserve.tooltip: Ụda dị n'ụwa na-ahapụ 16 n'ime ọwa ụda ụda 247 n'efu, ya mere iju mmiri nke ha (nnukwu mgbawa) enweghị ike imechi bọtịnụ menu.
horizon.extras.wheel_cycles_list_setting: Igwe mpịgharị dị n'elu bọtịnụ na ndepụta ntọala na-agbanwe uru ya. Gbanyụọ, dịka na vanilla, wheel na-akpọgharị ndepụta ahụ.
horizon.friends.code_ready: Koodu ịkpọ oku gị adịla njikere: NchNhr Egwuregwu, Soro ndị enyi gwuo egwu. Detuo ya ma ziga ya ndị enyi gị.

horizon.friends.relay_stopped: Koodu mkpụmkpụ na-ezighi ezi karịrị oke, ya mere relay agbanyụrụ ruo mgbe i ga-ekerịta ọzọ. Ndị enyi ka nwere ike iso na koodu zuru oke.

horizon.pvp.combat_feel.tooltip: Legacy na-ese ọgụ dịka 1.8.9 si eme: ihe dị n'aka gị, ọkụ ya, iri nri, ụta na mma agha ewelitere mgbe i jidere use, na-enweghị mgbada mgbe ọkụ ọ bụla gasịrị ma ọ bụ ihe ngosi ịwakpo. Naanị anya: ihe i na-eziga sava na-anọgide otu.
horizon.pvp.combat_indicator.tooltip: Na-edebe ihe ngosi ịwakpo n'okpuru Legacy, nke 1.8.9 enweghị.
horizon.pvp.combat_rules.tooltip: Otu onye na ụwa ị mepere na LAN na-alụ ọgụ n'iwu 1.8.9: enweghị attack cooldown ma ọ bụ sweep, mmebi ngwa agha 1.8, Strength, Sharpness na ọkụ critical. Sava ị jikọtara na-edebe iwu ha.
horizon.pvp.combat_sounds.tooltip: N'okpuru Legacy, na-ahapụ ụda ọkụ 1.9 gbakwunyere (ike, adịghị ike, sweep, critical...). Ụda mmerụ ahụ na-anọgide.
horizon.pvp.crosshair.tooltip: Na-ese crosshair gị kama nke vanilla. Ntọala mbụ ya yiri nke vanilla.
horizon.pvp.crosshair_colour.tooltip: Inverted na-egosi agba dị n'okpuru ya ntụgharị, dịka crosshair vanilla na-eme.
horizon.pvp.crosshair_hover.tooltip: Agba ọzọ mgbe crosshair dị n'elu mob ma ọ bụ onye ọkpụkpọ i nwere ike ịkụ, dịka ihe ngosi ịwakpo vanilla maara.

horizon.pvp.crosshair_shape.tooltip: Obe, T, X, okirikiri, skwịr ma ọ bụ naanị ntụpọ.

horizon.pvp.crosshair_thickness.tooltip: Otú ahịrị ọ bụla si obosara.

horizon.pvp.fire_lower.tooltip: Na-ebugharị ọkụ ị na-ahụ mgbe ị na-ere ọkụ gaa ala, ka ha kpuchie obere akụkụ ihuenyo.
horizon.pvp.glint_colour.tooltip: Agba nchapụ na ihe na ngwa agha enchantment. Gbanyụọ bụ odo odo vanilla.

horizon.pvp.hit_opacity.tooltip: Otú agba ahụ si kpuchie ha.

horizon.pvp.hud_armour_percent.tooltip: Ojiji fọdụrụ dịka pasent nke oke nke ihe ahụ kama ọnụọgụ.
horizon.pvp.hud_background.tooltip: Obere igbe ojii n'azụ widget ọ bụla.
horizon.pvp.hud_combo.tooltip: Ọkụ n'usoro sava kwadoro, ruo mgbe e merụrụ gị ahụ ma ọ bụ sekọnd 3 gafere na-enweghị otu.
horizon.pvp.hud_coords.tooltip: Ọnọdụ blọk gị na ntụgharị ihu gị, dịka F3 na-egosi ha. Ezo ya mgbe ụwa ma ọ bụ sava belatara F3.

horizon.pvp.hud_editor_key.tooltip: Na-emeghe ndezi HUD site na egwuregwu. Pịa, wee pịa igodo; Escape na-ewepụ njikọ ya.
horizon.pvp.hud_effects.tooltip: Mmetụta gị na aha ha, ọkwa ha na oge fọdụrụ, n'ọnọdụ akara dị n'elu aka nri.

horizon.pvp.hud_held.tooltip: Otú ihe dị n'aka gị si dị na inventory gị; akụ na ụta ma ọ bụ crossbow.
horizon.pvp.hud_keys.tooltip: Igodo mmegharị gị, bọtịnụ òké na ịwụ elu, na-enwu mgbe i jidere ha, yana pịa kwa sekọnd.
horizon.pvp.hud_opacity.tooltip: Otú igbe ndị dị n'azụ widget si gbaa ọchịchịrị.
horizon.pvp.hud_ping.tooltip: Oge nzaghachi sava na-akọ maka gị, na millisecond. Naanị multiplayer.

horizon.pvp.hud_server.tooltip: Adreesị sava ị na-egwu na ya. Naanị multiplayer.
horizon.pvp.hud_shadow.tooltip: Onyinyo n'okpuru ederede widget, dịka ederede HUD vanilla nwere.
horizon.pvp.hud_speed.tooltip: Otú i si aga ngwa ngwa n'ala, na blọk kwa sekọnd.
